name: maxifoot.fr
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But HSTS is not sent.
lesson: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, so browsers never try plain http again.
summary: www.maxifoot.fr scores 57 out of 100 (D). 9 checks fail now, 31 are at risk, and 21 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 105 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /mercato/, /club/marseille.110.htm, /club/paris-sg.115.htm and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 5192 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 429 elements on /, /mercato/, /club/marseille.110.htm, for example #topnav > a and #pubPR_ep728 > .ads-placeholderjc. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 241 elements on /, /mercato/, /club/marseille.110.htm, for example #E2T1 and #E2C1. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: The start page has no viewport tag
fix.evidence: Without it, phones render the desktop layout zoomed out. Google indexes the mobile version first.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The page fits a 990 px phone screen
The largest element paints in 0.4 s
Every page has a meta description
